name: labs/imswitch2__imswitch2
title: ImSwitch2 Standa rotation mount
intro: ImSwitch2 Standa rotation mount, adapted from imswitch2/imswitch2. It reads `position`; runs `move_absolute` and `stop_motion`. `move_absolute`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/imswitch2__imswitch2 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/imswitch2__imswitch2 --backend fake --mcp
